digest.component_or_area: Completion verifier (step budget, verdict caching, recovery pool)
propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts prematurely on valid multi-criterion (especially epic) workloads despite runaway already guarded by tool_calls_limit and loop detection, causing false FAIL verdicts on legitimate unproven criteria.

Budget formula lacks evidence-surface scaling term for child ticket traversal; story-calibrated per-criterion cost ignores epic overhead (5–10 requests per child), undersizing budget for multi-child tickets.
Every re-verification re-proves all criteria from scratch; no cross-run persistence of validated PASS verdicts wastes wall-clock (≈10 min/cycle) and enables attestation-laundering pressure.

Cache must key on scoped content fingerprint (git blob SHAs of file_impact paths, unioned for epicchildren) and criterion text, not whole-tree SHA, to survive unrelated commits and --ref-targeted verification.
Seeded cached PASS entries must be excluded from primary work surface and bypass finalizer downgrade judgment, while same-run and non-seeded downgrades remain preserved.
